pS1: Dear adventurers! Welcome to our short quad biking tour - the ideal way to enjoy nature, explore beauty, and experience the thrill of adrenaline while discovering unforgettable landscapes and breathtaking views!
pS2: Let`s embark on this unforgettable adventure: Our adventure starts from the center of Budva, prepared for the unforgettable experience that awaits us.
pS3: First, we`ll visit Jaz beach, where you`ll have the opportunity for photography and creating memories to cherish forever. After that, we continue our journey towards the beautiful beaches of Trsteno and Ploče, where you`ll also have the chance for photography and enjoying the tranquility of nature.
pS4: Next, we`ll visit the famous national restaurant Carević, offering a perfect view for relaxation and refreshing drinks. We continue our route through the village called Glavati, which also offers spectacular views, all the way to a Montenegrin restaurant with a waterfall, where we`ll stop to further enjoy.
pS5: Finally, we return back to Budva, now with even more beautiful views of the city, and along the way, children will have the opportunity to play and enjoy themselves.
pS6: This short tour is perfect for those who want to explore nature, enjoy beautiful landscapes, and feel the excitement of quad biking.
pS7: See you on the road! Warm regards, Your team for quad biking adventures.

routeGrand: Budva Center - Jazz Beach - Ploče Beach - Church St. George - Kubasi - Bigova - Luštica Bay - Fortress Gorazda - Church St. Ilija - Krapina - Budva Center
pG1: Dear adventurers, excitement reaches its peak as we present to you our extraordinary big quad biking tour that will take you on an unforgettable journey through spectacular landscapes and extraordinary adventures! Get ready for something that will leave you breathless! Departure from the heart of Budva!
pG2: Our adventure begins right here, in the heart of this enchanting city, ready to explore the wilderness that awaits us together! We kick off our adventure by visiting three heavenly beaches: Jaz, Trsteno, and Ploče! These oases of peace and beauty will give you the opportunity to pause, take a deep breath, and forever capture a moment in your camera and in your heart! And then, an exciting ride takes us to the magical Bigova!
pG3: Here we`ll stop to refresh ourselves and enjoy a refreshing swim, surrounded by the enchanting scents of flowers and the forest. Without stopping, we continue towards Luštica, a magical place known for its beauty and breathtaking landscapes! Here we`ll stop to catch our breath and create unforgettable memories that will last a lifetime! Our adventure culminates with a visit to the Gorazda fortress above Kotor! Built during the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy in 1885, this fortress offers spectacular views of the coastal beauty that will take your breath away!
pG4: Our return to Budva takes us through wooded landscapes to one of the most beautiful churches - the Church of St. Elijah. Here we`ll stop to feel the spirit of the past and enjoy the silence of nature.
pG5: To conclude this unforgettable adventure, we`ll visit an authentic Montenegrin restaurant that exudes the spirit of nature. The route to the restaurant is full of surprises, and the waterfall that greets us will further enrich our experience!
pG6: Finally, we return to Budva via an asphalt road, providing you with a beautiful view of the city as we descend down the road. This ride will fill you with adrenaline and delight you with the charms of nature!
pG7: This tour is more than just a journey - it`s an experience that will inspire you, empower you, and leave you breathless! Get ready for the unforgettable adventure that awaits you!
pG8: See you on the road! Warm regards, Your team for quad biking adventures.
warningRules: Please make sure to read the rules below !
descriptionText: Quad driving safety rules, Drivers must be over 18 and hold a valid driver`s license. All passengers must be over 12 years old. Each driver and passenger will undergo training to learn how to drive the quad before the start of the excursion. Driving a quad is much more dangerous than driving a car. Each driver is responsible for the driver next to him. This system is called (buddy system) and it is an added security measure. In order to ensure the safety of the vehicle, the driver must be in good physical and mental condition. Practical shoes also required. No high heels or open-toed sandals. The consumption of alcohol or drugs is strictly prohibited before and during the excursion. If the driver notices inappropriate behavior or suspects drug or alcohol abuse, he has the right to exclude the person from the tour. By checking the general conditions of sale, all drivers and passengers are responsible for their actions. The company or the guide cannot be held responsible for accidents, material damage or bodily injury. Driver clients must hand over their driver`s licenses and/or passports to the guide and read and sign the terms and conditions of the rental agreement and sign the (disclaimer) as well as acceptance at the overall risk of driving a quad Before the ride begins, drivers must also sign a deposit confirmation to leave one. In case of possible damage, the driver will be detained at the police station and subject to legal procedure in Montenegro until the damage is reimbursed (in case the deposit does not cover the damage) It is strictly forbidden to use a mobile phone during the journey. Some places are provided for photo stops. Photo taking is permitted when the quads are parked and the engine is off. During the journey, mobile phones must be placed in the rear compartment of the vehicle. Don`t do anything that might distract you from safe driving and always keep both hands on the wheel. One-handed driving is not permitted. Quads are not vehicles equipped with roll bars or cabins. So the only protection is the gear you wear. This is the reason why the driver and the passenger do not have to remove their helmets which are provided. The minimum distance between 2 quads must be 5 meters. Please do not leave keys in the lock while the quad is unattended Please note that it is prohibited: Abuse of alcohol or drugs while driving the vehicle Mobile phone use while traveling Take photos during the trip Operate the steering wheel when tired Always wear a helmet! Keep your legs firmly on the support Relax your elbows when driving Practice easy start Test the reactions of the quad when you press the accelerator brake before going on an excursion.
